mapper.insert: INSERT INTO compensation_log (action_key, handler, payload, status, attempts, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{record.actionKey}, #{record.handler}, #{record.payload}, #{record.status}, #{record.attempts}, #{record.updatedAt}, #{record.updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE compensation_log SET status = 'EXECUTED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE action_key = #{actionKey} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE compensation_log SET status = 'COMPENSATING', claim_token = #{claimToken}, claimed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE action_key = #{actionKey} AND status IN ('EXECUTED', 'FAILED')
UPDATE compensation_log SET status = 'COMPENSATED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE action_key = #{actionKey} AND status IN ('EXECUTED', 'COMPENSATING')
UPDATE compensation_log SET status = 'FAILED', attempts = attempts + 1, last_error = #{reason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE action_key = #{actionKey}
UPDATE compensation_log SET status = 'CONFIRMED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE action_key = #{actionKey} AND status IN ('EXECUTED', 'COMPENSATING')

UPDATE compensation_log SET status = 'EXECUTED', claim_token = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE status = 'COMPENSATING' AND claimed_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM compensation_log WHERE status = 'EXECUTED' ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM compensation_log WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM compensation_log WHERE status = 'FAILED' ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
